feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: πClideaN MPC 1.3.2
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.0
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.2
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.0
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: PotentialWax 1.2.2
entry.summary: Melodic sampler in the spirit of Serato Sample: picks or browses songs from your own folders (MP3, WAV or FLAC), detects tempo and key, sets 16 cue points (phrases, bars or hits) on the pads and matches them to your tempo and key, with time-stretch or vinyl-style pitching. Save the chops as WAVs.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.0.2
entry.summary: Calibrated pink noise reference for the pink-noise mixing method: one-tap RMS levels from -24 to -12 dB, mono or stereo, full or 40 Hz-16 kHz range, live RMS and peak reading and a level meter.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.4
entry.summary: Drum-break slicer: picks a random break from your own break folders (WAV or FLAC), chops it to 8 or 16 slices or by hits across the pads and matches it to the project tempo, by re-pitching or stretching. Shuffle the slices and save the groove as MIDI.

entry.summary: Add, remove and turn on or off the plugins in a project's inserts from a RACK page on the Sample. APPLY saves and restarts MPC: save first.

entry.title: Monomodule One + FX 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument, plus its 7 effect machines as an audio effect, each with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and preset lists, and Q-Links. A ready-made download: nothing of Elektron's is in the zip; you put your own Monomachine OS file in the plugin folder and it makes its skin and sound from that. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Monomodule FX (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's seven effect machines (thru, reverb, chorus, dynamix, ring mod, phaser, flanger) as an audio effect for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: it reads your own Monomachine OS file from the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: Puts any Machinemodule tracks, and its reverb and delay sends, on their own MPC return or FX track, so MPC's mixer and effects can process them. Needs Machinemodule in the same project. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Machinemodule (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum UW sound engine as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: 16 tracks in one plugin, touchscreen skin, bank and kit lists, Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: you add your own OS file (and optionally your flash image) in the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule 1.0.3
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Keyscope 1.0.4
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

entry.title: Chordsmith 1.0.4
entry.summary: Chord tool: pads, keys or chord buttons play scale, set or custom chords with voicing, strum, arp and harp modes, MIDI out to other tracks and a built-in preview synth.

entry.title: Xenia 0.1.2
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: Tuney 1.4.3
entry.summary: Real-time vocal pitch correction: key and scale or your own notes on a touch keyboard, a pitch dial, Retune, Transition, Amount, Vibrato and Humanize, voice ranges and a reference pitch. Presets from hard tune to subtle.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.1
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Sonix 0.3.12
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries.

entry.title: Shapey EQ 1.6.2
entry.summary: An 8-band parametric EQ you shape by touch: tap or drag on the curve, drag numbered dots, and make any band a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency, presets and four themes.

entry.title: Shapey 5-Band EQ 1.0.1
entry.summary: The 5-band version of Shapey EQ, made for touch: every band has its own lane under a taller curve, so any dot drags directly. Any band can be a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency.
